name: Ledger from Tanaris
summary: After Caught!, the occupant of the wooden outhouse in Searing Gorge offers you a small job taken on in Tanaris. Krinkle Goodsteel in Gadgetzan wants certain things found in the gorge and a few other places, and you are to collect them and bring them to him.

sections.title: A Job from Tanaris
sections.body: Having been helped, the occupant recalls a little job taken on while in Tanaris. Krinkle Goodsteel of Gadgetzan wants a list of things gathered, some from this gorge and some from elsewhere. Goodsteel's ledger will be slid under the door for you, and you are to carry it, along with everything on it, to Goodsteel in Tanaris.

sections.title: What the Ledger Lists
sections.body: The ledger lists twenty solid crystal leg shafts, which come from the glassweb spiders of Searing Gorge, and an overdue package. The package is at a crashed zeppelin at Beezil's Wreck, in Dustwallow Marsh. The third item, Goodsteel's balanced flameberge, is held by Jarquia, a murloc along the eastern shore of the Swamp of Sorrows.
